headline: Jaiprakash Power Ventures shares slide 30% over six months amid profit decline
hook: Three sessions of losses follow Q2 drop
summary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures shares have fallen for three consecutive sessions following a sharp drop in net profit for the second quarter of fiscal 2026. The stock has experienced a 30% correction over the past six months, raising concerns among retail investors. Analysts and market experts have shared views and target prices on whether the stock can recover. Indian retail shareholders face continued volatility as the company grapples with weak quarterly earnings.
whats_next: Next quarterly earnings or company strategic updates
why_it_matters: JP Power shareholders face continued downside amid weak earnings

headline: Jaiprakash Power reports 82 percent fall in Q2 net profit
hook: Sharp profit drop at Jaiprakash Power
summary: Jaiprakash Power Ventures posted a net profit of ₹33 crore for the second quarter, marking an 82 percent decline year-on-year. The steep drop followed a settlement with the National Asset Reconstruction Company Ltd (NARCL). Brokerage firm Motilal Oswal covered the results. Retail investors holding the stock face compressed margins and lower profitability following the debt-related resolution.
why_it_matters: Lower earnings and debt resolution impact stock sentiment.

headline: Jaipower Power Ventures announces the retirement of its CFO and Company Secretary
hook: Key managerial personnel exit at JP Power
summary: Jaipower Power Ventures has announced the cessation of its Chief Financial Officer and Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer, who are key managerial personnel. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Such leadership exits in compliance and finance roles require monitoring for corporate governance stability.
